info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v5-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payouts API provides access to a comprehensive list of insurance claims payouts. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding the payouts associated with various insurance claims, aiding in financial analysis and reporting. Typical consumers include claims adjusters, financial analysts, and insurance professionals who need to track and manage claim payouts efficiently. By utilizing this API, users can gain insights into payout trends and make informed decisions based on the financial data of claims.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access detailed payout information associated with their claims. It provides insights into the payout amounts and relevant timelines involved in the claims process.
